slug: 2026-02-01 DRC unveils $8.7 billion digital plan to expand connectivity and AI skills by 2030

facts.fact: iAfrica reports the DRC's 2026-2030 digital transformation plan (PNN2) at US$8.7 billion, with targets of 650 more communities connected (about 30 million people and 1,000 institutions), 700,000 jobs and 9.7 million new mobile internet users by 2029; funders cited include the World Bank and AFD.

systems.tiers: national; connectivity, modernising public services, tech skills, interbank payment platform
